name: Document: Write the module standard
text_content:
I11 and P33. What every training module must contain, do, and refuse, with canon on every word: the procedure as decisions, a Loom recording of a real person where physical, the range it touches, the languages, the author and approver and version, and the readiness row it feeds; no script beyond the house's one arrival line, no gloss of a Korean term, no synthesized presenter before A7 is ruled, no scoring quiz, no competency taught as required that field 7 says is developed, and the six binary tests sentence by sentence. Defines "qualified" to author as holding the validated competency, and the approvers by content class. High.

Filed by Session 7 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhrz. Reasoning lives on the S7 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

S13 page, sections 11.1 and 11.2; P32.
